claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_touching_ground
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item activation has a real grounded-use gate that cannot be represented by the existing holding/wearing predicates.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.commandRange.unspecified
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The summon obeys commands, but the text gives no numeric command radius; the current required `commandRangeFeet` field forces invented data.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.defaultBehavior.unspecified
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The control surface currently requires a fallback behavior even when the source text does not define one.
